name: v4
library: Available library: IC Reactor 4 — `@ic-reactor/core`, a client that calls canisters and builds TanStack Query options, and `@ic-reactor/react` for React — over the module `candid-core-cli gen` generated from the ledger's `.did` in `src/generated/icrc1.ts` (`@candid-core/schema` 0.3.0-beta.1), with `@icp-sdk/core`, `@icp-sdk/auth` and TanStack Query (`@tanstack/react-query`, `@tanstack/query-core`). Its documentation is in `docs/`; read it before you start.
